worldcombat.skill.headlongrush.summary: Lowers its head and drills straight ahead at full weight: a running full-body tackle that shoves the foe along and tears a short-lived furrow of raw earth out of the ground. As it starts, the user's Defense and Sp. Def each drop one stage. The plowing form reaches farther, shoves harder and cuts a wider furrow at the cost of lower power and a slower cast.
worldcombat.skill.headlongrush.use.0: Charge in from range and knock a foe out of position
worldcombat.skill.headlongrush.use.1: Trade body weight for one heaviest hit
worldcombat.skill.headlongrush.use.2: Leave a furrow of broken ground in the world
worldcombat.skill.headlongrush.descripti: Charges low along the committed straight line: every foe met along the way takes about %1$s physical damage and is knocked %2$s blocks along the impact line before the charge pushes on, stopping at a solid wall.

Charge range %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick; the path is churned into a %3$s-block-wide furrow of coarse dirt (cracked stone at the impact), which stays for %4$s ticks and then restores the original blocks.

The guard is spent as the move starts: the user's Defense drops %1$s stage(s) and Sp. Def drops %2$s, hit or miss; both stay until the user goes a long time without attacking or being hurt, or leaves the fight.
worldcombat.skill.headlongrush.plow.on: Plowing form: charge range x1.15, knock-back x1.2 and furrow x1.3, at the cost of impact power x0.92, wind-up +2 ticks, recovery +3 ticks and cooldown +5 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.headlongrush.plow.off: Short form (default): charge range x0.95 with a shorter shove and a narrower furrow than the plowing form, but a heavier single hit, a faster cast and a shorter cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.headlongrush.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.headlongrush.growth.0: From level %1$s the impact power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.headlongrush.growth.1: From level %1$s the impact power rises to %2$s and the charge range to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.headlongrush.preferenc: On: charge range x1.15, knock-back x1.2, furrow x1.3; costs impact power x0.92, wind-up +2 ticks, recovery +3 ticks and cooldown +5 ticks. Off (bracing): stops dead on contact, heavier single hit and faster cast, but a shorter shove and furrow.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger opens from farther, but it is easier to sidestep mid-charge.
Only at least this far away will it prefer this move; up close there is no room to build momentum. Closer scores lower so other moves take over.
On: low-health targets rank higher so one heavy single hit finishes them before the price is paid; off: all targets score the same.
Below this own health ratio the user holds Headlong Rush back (0 = no limit). Higher saves it for a worthwhile trade.
